# Why I want to attend BioC

I am applying for the travel award because finances are nebulous as I transition from being a PhD to becoming a postdoc. As my thesis lab ran out of funds, I started working at the flow cytometry core here at the University of Maryland, Baltimore while wrapping up my dissertation writing. Given the current fiscal climate, like many academic shared resource facilities here in the United States, our user-base usage is down and consequently there has been institutional belt tightening. Receiving a travel award would help defray the cost associated with travel, and given I am very frugal when attending conferences, make it possible to attend in the event that the staff self-improvement funds are slashed by the institution between now and then.
